messages:
Maria (Platform): heads-up — noticed a weird reconnect loop for customers on the new routing policy. appears when quota enforcement kicks in during a resume. reproducible on staging.
Dan (Runtime): ugh. what does "resume" look like in the logs? is the resume token being preserved across the handoff?
Maria (Platform): log snippet:
```
[2026-03-17T18:12:02Z] conn=42 resume_id=abc123 route=pool-b -> pool-c
[2026-03-17T18:12:02Z] quota.check tenant=tenant-x allowed_tokens=0 -> disconnect
[2026-03-17T18:12:02Z] resume: session abc123 not found in KV -> instruct client to reconnect
```
Sam (DevEx): so the runtime drops the connection for quota, then the client reconnects with resume_id=abc123, but the router has already moved session ownership to a different pool and the new pool doesn't have the KV entry. client tries to resume -> fails -> reconnects -> repeat. loop.
Jen (SRE): that would create a tight retry loop from the client side. are we seeing increased egress/calls? any billing risk? :eyes:
Maria (Platform): yes, we've got inflight spikes in connections and token accounting gets messy. some customers saw rapid token counts because resumed traffic was double-counted as new in the short window.
Dan (Runtime): two things to separate: (A) behavioral bug (resume token mismatch across pools) and (B) quota semantics on resumed streams. do we treat resume as continuing same quota window or a new request?
Sam (DevEx): UX note — console rollout toggle "resume_on_reconnect" is currently global; product wants it per-tenant. rollout made the routing move more aggressively which exposed this.
Maria (Platform): repro steps I used:
1) enable resume_on_reconnect
2) start streaming SSE with resume_id header
3) force routing rebalance (scale down pool-a)
4) artificially drop conn when quota hits 0
5) client reconnects with resume_id -> failure

cURL showing resume header:
```
curl -v -H "Resume-Session: abc123" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream
```
Dan (Runtime): short-term patch idea: during quota enforcement, instead of full disconnect, return a soft throttle response that preserves the resume token and marks session as "paused:quota" on the router for 30s. client sees 429-with-resume and can backoff. short-term should avoid moving session ownership until paused window expires.
Jen (SRE): sounds safer than dropping. reduces churn. we should also add client backoff guidance in SDKs.
Sam (DevEx): console change: add per-tenant toggle + explainers ("If enabled, resumed sessions may be paused instead of disconnected when quotas are hit — experimental"). also add alerting rule for resume-failure rate > 1%.
Maria (Platform): long-term: make session ownership canonical in the control plane so resume tokens can be routed to owner via control-plane mapping (not local pool KV). also add a consistent session lease that survives short rebalances.
Dan (Runtime): agreed. will also: (1) ensure resume token signed with owner id, (2) try to fetch session from control plane if local KV miss, (3) add delta-counter so resumed streams don't count twice in billing window.
Maria (Platform): propose immediate action items:
- Dan: implement soft-throttle-on-quota in runtime and fallback fetch from control-plane (owner lookup) — P0, today->tomorrow
- Sam: add per-tenant toggle + console copy and alert — P1, this week
- Jen: add SLO alert for resume-failure rate + throttling dashboard panels — P1
- Maria: write rollout doc and customer comms template if we need to toggle off for some accounts — P2

Dan (Runtime): I'll open a PR for the soft-throttle change and add unit tests for resume token handling. attaching infra job: https://ci.redwood.example/job/1234 :hammer_and_wrench:
OpsBot: Deployment planned: runtime/soft-throttle PR #456 -> staging; ETA 30m. Notifying oncall.
Jen (SRE): I'll monitor connection churn during rollout. if connections > 2x baseline, we rollback.
Sam (DevEx): SDK note: implement exponential backoff on resume failures, and expose explicit hook to opt into resume behavior. I'll draft a quick changelog.
Maria (Platform): thanks all. labeling this thread for follow-up: resume-quota-reconnect-loop. ping @Dan when PR is ready. :+1:
Dan (Runtime): pinged — PR #456 opened. will link the QA checklist.
Maria (Platform): closing the loop — once soft-throttle is live in staging, we'll run the repro script and validate telemetry tags: `resume.session_id`, `resume.owner`, `resume.result` (ok|fallback|missing_kv). need those dimensions in dashboards.
Sam (DevEx): will add those fields to the console streaming telemetry view.
Jen (SRE): ack. rolling watch window set for 1 hour after deploy.
Maria (Platform): great. thanks everyone :rocket:
